description: GraveGain5D: transcend the GraveGain multiverse. Same 4D hypercube golf and 3D models, plus universe-hopping across 6 parallel universes with chain-hop combos, paradox meter, and collapsing-universe timers. Crazier than 4D: every hop rewrites gravity, W-drift, and par.
instructions: Pick a starting universe and tee off. Hop universes (U) to dodge 4D hazards, chain hops for combo multipliers, and watch the paradox meter — overcharge collapses the universe you are standing in. Clear holes across universes to reach the Prime Array.
